senses.gloss: m. (ποτήριον) poterion, name of a shrub (Astragalus Poterium), a species of tragacanth, yielding a gum which was used for spicing wines; פיילי פ׳ a vial of poterion, a medicinal drink taken after bathing.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 51">Gen. R. s. 51</cite> (ref. to <he>מנת כוסם</he>, <cite ref="Psalms 11:6">Ps. XI, 6</cite>) <he>כפ׳ פ׳ לאחר המרחץ</he> (not <cite ref="Q00641"><he>פיטרין</he></cite>) like the vial of poterion after a bath; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 10:1:7">Y. Pes. X, 37ᶜ</cite> top <he>דיפלי פ׳ כדיפלי פ׳ וכ׳</he> (corr. acc.); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 655">Yalk. Ps. 655</cite> (not <cite ref="Q00198"><he>פוטרין</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 10:7">Gen. R. s. 10</cite> <he>כיון שיצא הביאו פ׳ פ׳ של יין לשתותו</he> when he (Titus) came out of the bath, they handed him a vial of poterion wine to drink; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 5:8:4">Koh. R. to V, 8</cite> <he>כוס פ׳ פ׳ של יין</he> (not <cite ref="Q00198"><he>פוטרין</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 88:3">Gen. R. s. 88</cite> <he>זבוב נמצא בתוך פ׳ פ׳ שלו</he> a fly was found in his (Pharaoh’s) vial &c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 146:6">Yalk. ib. 146</cite> <he>סילי פושרין</he> (corr. acc.).
